DANDYS WORLD: FINN GOES TWISTED

Shrimpo recently got a job as an astronaut and is preparing for his trip to space. In an effort to show off to all his Gardenview friends he invited them all over to come see his rocket. Shrimpo's all-time best friend Finn however doesn't like what sees as Shrimpo and Goob show signs of getting a bit too close for his comfort.
